output.title: HTTP01 PathType Exact: environment shows no ACME issuer or Ingress
output.content: The change affects ACME HTTP01 challenges that are solved through Ingress routes. The environment summary shows only apps/v1 Deployment and cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifests, and only the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer, no ACME or HTTP01 solver configuration, and no Ingress controller. The one related key is global.rbac.disableHTTPChallengesRole, but the excerpt does not link it to this change. The operator should check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer outside these inputs uses an ACME http01 ingress solver. If one does, they should check whether its Ingress controller handles Exact paths. The excerpt is truncated before it names the incompatible controllers.
